title: TEST FIXTURE - method for hydrothermal relithiation of degraded layered oxide cathodes
abstract: Invented test record. A degraded NMC811 cathode powder recovered from spent lithium-ion batteries is relithiated hydrothermally in a lithium hydroxide solution and then annealed to restore capacity.
claims: 1. A method for regenerating a spent LiNi0.8Mn0.1Co0.1O2 cathode material, comprising: separating cathode powder from a current collector; relithiating the cathode powder in a LiOH solution at 180-240 °C; and annealing the relithiated cathode powder at 800-900 °C.
2. The method of claim 1, wherein the LiOH concentration is 2-4 M.

title: TEST FIXTURE - leaching of black mass with sulfuric acid and hydrogen peroxide
abstract: Invented test record. Black mass from shredded batteries is leached in 2 M sulfuric acid with hydrogen peroxide as reductant at 80 °C, and cobalt and nickel are separated by solvent extraction with Cyanex 272.
claims: 1. A process for recovering metals from black mass, comprising: leaching the black mass in sulfuric acid with hydrogen peroxide; and separating cobalt by solvent extraction.

title: TEST FIXTURE - chemical relithiation of lithium iron phosphate
abstract: Invented test record. Spent LiFePO4 is relithiated with a lithium salt and a mild reductant at room temperature.

title: TEST FIXTURE - later relithiation filing published after the priority date
abstract: Invented test record. Hydrothermal relithiation of NMC811 cathode powder in LiOH at 220 °C followed by annealing at 850 °C.

title: TEST FIXTURE - perovskite solar module encapsulation
abstract: Invented test record. An encapsulant for perovskite photovoltaic modules.
